 A pre-release of CADD v1.7 for genome build GRCh37 - CADD v1.7-pre - is online. 
 We provide genome-wide SNV scores for CADD v1.7 . However, when having multiple VEP
 consequences per variant due to overlapping genes, in this pre-release version we randomly select one of the genes. 
 We recognized that this behavior can result in potentially lower CADD-scores , as the more
 severe consequence from the other gene is missed in scoring. We currently recalculate genome-wide scores, providing 
 the most severe transcript consequence for each gene annotated, while provide the highest possible CADD score for all
 annotations lines of such variants (as in previous versions). We expect these files to be ready by the end of 2023. 
 The CADD v1.7-pre release will be completely deleted afterwards! . Please use these currently 
 released scores only for exploratory purposes and not in any clinical applications. 
 -->
 Due to a hardware failure, CADD v1.7 online scoring has been offline. The system is back and we are observing the system more closely. Scoring is currently working through a longer queue. CADD scores for releases v1.0 to v1.6 can be obtained without delays. Please consider using the single variant or range lookup as well as our pre-scored files available in the download section. In this section, you can also find all required files to install CADD v1.7 locally for scoring new variants (e.g., MNVs and InDels). Sorry for the inconvenience. --> 
 Note: Scoring of VCF files with CADD v1.7 is still rather slow if many new
 variants need to be calculated from scratch (e.g., if many insertion/deletion or multi-nucleotide substitutions
 are included). If possible use the pre-scored whole genome and pre-calculated indel files directly where possible. 
 Note: We are expecting small delays and possibly incomplete files around President's Day (Feb 15, 2016) due to a network file system move. We will keep the webserver running anyways and check for incomplete and missing files after the move is complete on Tuesday (Feb 16). We will automatically re-initiate scoring of those sets. If you believe your download has been incomplete, just download again on Tuesday afternoon (PST). -->
 The US site of the CADD webserver and variant scoring will be offline on Jan 8 2024 due to some network maintenance work. Please consider using our alternate site in Germany. Sorry for the inconvenience. 
-->
 The CADD webserver currently works through a long queue of submitted variants. About 36 million variants in more than 380 submission were uploaded since Dec 9 and we are providing limited computational resources to the processing (at most 25 submissions are processed in parallel). Your results will get available eventually and will be available for six weeks after submission. If you are interested in many variants, please consider downloading the pre-calculated files rather than submitting many large requests to the webserver. If you have questions about retrieving large sets of variants without using the webform, please contact us. -->
 IT is working on some network file system issues. It seems that some submissions were not processed because of that (empty output file). We restarted jobs that were clearly incomplete and will monitor processing more closely over the next days. If you encounter unexpected behavior, please send an email to mkircher [at] uw.edu with the submission identifier (name of the link provided after upload/filename of the download). -->
 We are currently updating the CADD webserver. If you encounter unexpected behavior, please be patient and try again. If your problems persist, please send an email to mkircher [at] uw.edu -->
 The CADD webserver has moved to new hardware. Due to some issues with getting everything going on the new hardware, we are watching the server closely right now. If you encounter unexpected behavior, please send an email to mkircher [at] uw.edu -->
 The scoring form of the CADD webserver is currently offline as required file shares are currently offline. You can submit your data but it will not be processed until all systems are back online. We were able to establish a workaround for CADD v1.3. Scoring for older releases will only be possible once all systems are back online. Please come again soon. Please also consider using the single variant lookup as well as our files available in the download section. Sorry for the inconvenience. -->
 The CADD webserver has a long queue of submitted variants. More than 10 million variants in more than 400 submission were uploaded over the last hours and we are providing limited computational resources to the processing (at most 25 submissions are processed in parallel). Your results will get available eventually and will be available for six weeks after submission. If you are interested in many variants, please consider downloading the pre-calculated files rather than submitting many large requests to the webserver. If you have questions about retrieving large sets of variants without using the webform, please contact us. We would like to find an alternative solution with you. -->
 The CADD webserver is currently offline. You can submit your data but it will not be processed until a filesystem move finishes around 10:00AM PST on July 23 2014. Please come again soon. Sorry for the inconvenience. 
 If you uploaded a variant set to our webserver from July 9 2014 13:00 PST to July 10 2014 14:00 PST, your result files were probably empty or at least incomplete. The problem has been fixed. Please download your result file again. You can simply upload the original query file if you no longer have the download link. Sorry for the inconvenience. 
 If you uploaded a variant set that included InDels to our webserver from May 11 2014 23:00 PST to May 12 2014 9:00 PST, your result files did not contain the complete set of InDels. The problem has been fixed. Please download your result file again. You can simply upload the original query file if you no longer have the download link. Sorry for the inconvenience. 
 Due to a file system outage in the Department of Genome Sciences, it is currently not possible to retrieve variants using our webserver. Please come back soon. If you retrieved variant sets that included InDels in the last hours ( May 28 2014 1:00 AM PST to May 28 2014 10:00 AM PST ), your result files might be incomplete or incorrect. Please score them again once the servers are up again. Sorry for the inconvenience. 
 The CADD webserver is back online in an intermediate set-up. Due to a file system outage in the Department of Genome Sciences our system was offline for a little more than a day. If you retrieved variant sets that included InDels between May 28 2014 1:00 AM PST to May 28 2014 10:00 AM PST, your result files might be incomplete or incorrect. Please download them again. Sorry for the inconvenience. -->
 CADD scores are freely available for all non-commercial applications. If you are
 planning on using them in a commercial application, please obtain a license . If you have questions, please contact us .
 Due to the large file sizes, we highly recommend a download manager or another tool that allows you to continue
 interrupted downloads (e.g. wget -c).
 Note that the latest versions also have a separate download option via the install script.
